name: YUCLAW 7.0.1 — public-QA corrections: consistent coverage, complete evidence history, packaged EvidenceBench scorer, excerpt quality
body:
Research & education only. Not investment advice.

### YUCLAW 7.0.1 — Evidence-First Financial AI · The Science Trust Layer for Financial AI

Financial AI normally gives you an answer. YUCLAW gives you the evidence, what that evidence can support, what it cannot support, and whether that conclusion survived time.

#### Changed in 7.0.1 — patch: public-QA corrections (software and data presentation; no methodology change)

- Coverage: one shared artifact (`/coverage.json`) read by every surface, bound by as_of + sha256; a permanent same-metric consistency gate. The homepage-vs-Explorer differences came from renders taken from different generations of a moving artifact.
- Evidence history: `/why/{TICKER}.json` now declares its 100-object collection a PREVIEW with typed metadata; the complete per-name history ships as `/why/{TICKER}.history.json` bound to one build by `/why/history_manifest.json`; the as-of recipe distinguishes INCOMPLETE, COMPLETE, COMPLETE_EMPTY and OUT_OF_RANGE and filters by recorded availability.
- EvidenceBench: the scorer ships in the package (`yuclaw evidencebench score … --items …`, stdlib-only). Rubric v1 is reproduced exactly and its limitation is disclosed (a question echo scores 1.0 on accession-quoting items; v1 results do not measure groundedness; items and results byte-identical). Rubric v2 is a candidate structured-fact contract — not registered, no item set, no pooled leaderboard.
- Excerpt quality: detector rules, a display finalizer and separate correction annotations (`/evidence/excerpt_corrections.json`) that keep the original excerpt and hash; 68 detector hits on 3,586 unique public objects were verified against primary documents (43 corrected display excerpts, 25 confirmed flags, 0 unverified). The forward extraction gate ships OFF.
- Responsive tables: Explorer and Validation Lab tables scroll inside keyboard-focusable regions; a viewport gate checks every current public route at 390 px and 1440 px.
- Content: obsolete product wording removed from current copy; Signal Review states its actual availability; freshness stamps are per artifact (the data-through date and the UTC build time of that artifact; the trading-day phrase appears only when true).
